data.comment: Amazing taste! Highly recommended for spiritual offerings. The Khaja was extremely fresh, flaky, and had the perfect amount of sweetness. It reminded me of the authentic taste one gets directly at the Puri temple gates. I've tried many other brands, but Jay Subhdra definitely captures the essence of tradition. Excellent work!
Very fresh and authentic. Packaging could be better to avoid breakage during transit, as some pieces were slightly crushed when they arrived. However, the taste remains unbeatable. Jai Jagannath!

The silk quality is top-notch. Beautiful weave! The colors are vibrant and exactly as shown in the pictures. I wore it for a family function and received so many compliments. The Khandua silk is truly a masterpiece of Odia heritage.
Bought this for my parents and they loved it. The quality is consistent and the delivery was on time. Will definitely order again.
The Pattachitra art is exquisite. The detailing on the figures is very fine. It's a great addition to my home decor. Prompt shipping and safe packaging.
The Sankha has a very resonant sound. Very happy with the purchase. The size is just right for daily puja.
The Neem Wood moorti is beautifully carved. You can feel the craftsmanship. It arrived safely and was worth the wait.
Taste is good but felt it was a bit too oily this time. Previous batch was perfect.
Exceeded expectations. The silk has a beautiful sheen and the border design is very traditional. Highly satisfied with Jay Subhdra's quality.
The oil painting is a masterpiece. The colors are so deep and the expression on Lord Jagannath's face is very serene. Truly blessed to have this in my home.
